response.sql: WITH item_averages AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, c.town_city AS town, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city), town_averages AS (SELECT town, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM item_averages GROUP BY town), cross_town AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM town_averages) SELECT t.town, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - x.avg_ratio AS ratio_excess FROM town_averages AS t CROSS JOIN cross_town AS x WHERE t.avg_ratio > x.avg_ratio

assumptions.assumption: A missing town is excluded; a zero total cost makes the ratio undefined, so that ratio is ignored by AVG.
